notes: XI matches UEFA and Sky exactly, and Sky's position table (4-3-3, RW Salah, ST Firmino, LW Mane) matches the entry. UEFA's coordinates also put Lovren right and Van Dijk left, Milner right and Wijnaldum left of Henderson, as in the entry.
Date 2018-05-26, Final, NSC Olimpiyskiy Kyiv, Real Madrid 3-1 Liverpool all match.
'Andrew Robertson' in the entry, 'Andy Robertson' / 'A Robertson' in the sources: same man.

sources.says: 2021-05-29, Final, Estadio do Dragao, Porto, Man City 0-1 Chelsea. City XI: Ederson; Walker, Stones, Ruben Dias, Zinchenko; Gundogan; Bernardo Silva, Foden; Mahrez, De Bruyne, Sterling. Bench incl. Rodri, Fernandinho, Jesus, Aguero. Goal Havertz 42'.

Saturday 29th May 2021, Estadio do Dragao, Manchester City 0-1 Chelsea (Havertz 42'). XI: Ederson; K Walker, J Stones, R Alves Dias, O Zinchenko; B Silva, I Gundogan, P Foden, R Mahrez, K De Bruyne (c), R Sterling. Subs G Jesus 60' (De Bruyne), Fernandinho 64' (B Silva), S Aguero 77' (Sterling).

notes: XI matches UEFA and Sky exactly; Rodri and Fernandinho on UEFA's bench, as the entry's comment says. Date 2021-05-29, Final, Estadio do Dragao Porto, Manchester City 0-1 Chelsea (Havertz 42') all match.

Positions: UEFA's pitch coordinates put Gundogan deepest, Bernardo Silva right and Foden left, Mahrez right, Sterling left and De Bruyne central but deeper than the wide men (a false nine): exactly the entry's layout and comment. Sky's auto labels (Foden RM, Mahrez LM, Sterling ST, De Bruyne CAM) disagree on sides; the organiser is preferred and the entry matches it. Not counted.
Formation 4-3-3 is not labelled by either source; consistent with UEFA's coordinates.
